prompts.neutral: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent character sprite for Jianghu Chinese wuxia visual novel. One woman only, Shen Zhaowei 沈照微, age 30, Bagua martial practitioner, composed and competitive, recognizably adult angular oval face, warm brown eyes, dark hair in a practical low braided bun with one plain narrow jade hairpin. Full head to upper thighs, both elbows and hands fully inside frame, three quarter view facing slightly left toward player. Dark muted aubergine short outer jacket over ivory cross collar underrobe, charcoal narrow trousers, cloth hand wraps, practical tied sash, no armor, no sword, no cleavage. One hand lightly holding the opposite wrist ready to step, neutral attentive expression with slight skeptical raised brow, relaxed mouth. Highly detailed muted watercolor and ink illustration, fine naturalistic face, fabric wear, quiet jade and plum accents, match restrained historical wuxia character art. Genuine transparent alpha background, clean complete silhouette, soft even warm light. No scenery, no ground shadow, no text, no logo, no frame, no additional figures. This is an original interpretation, do not copy an existing character's face.

Preserve exactly her face identity and apparent age30, jade hairpin and braided bun, plum and ivory martial clothing with all existing embroidery and sash, framing head to thighs, silhouette and both hand positions, watercolor ink style and soft even lighting. Maintain complete transparent background and alpha, no scenery, no text, no frame, no other changes.
